items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for the managed fleet; blocked for SearchWoot public beta, go-live, new public exposure, notification expansion, monetization changes, and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence timestamp: 2026-10-01T04:50:05.408Z. The security baseline covers 61 managed sites, but fleet-doctor has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. No credentials, exploit evidence, or confirmed vulnerability is present. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown. Exact decision: preserve all existing private-launch and security-sensitive release gates; continue the existing read-only evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only; do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach. Reassess only when dated evidence supports the listed controls. This is risk triage, not penetration testing or certification.

Security recommendation: retain the candidate plan's containment decisions and reject the proposed three-site factory batch, duplicate delivery case, new telemetry, prototypes, and new admissions this cycle. The existing security evidence work is already canonical; do not create duplicate security requests. Keep SearchWoot private because access, data-flow, consent, vendor/logging, incident, release, and security evidence remain incomplete. The next security action is limited to completing the existing dated read-only control matrix and preserving unknowns rather than interpreting missing telemetry as a clean result.
